settings.name: R3
settings.text: Choose R3 if you want the best balance of comfort and airflow, in an appliance designed to feel gentler on the gums.
settings.points:
Gentler on the gums
Easier airflow
Great long-term option
1-year guarantee, one free replacement

settings.name: R2
settings.text: Choose R2 if you want a solid, durable appliance whose small air holes encourage breathing through the nose.
settings.points:
Durable through strong clenching
A good option for grinders
1-year guarantee, one free replacement

settings.name: R1
settings.text: Choose R1 if budget is your main priority and you are not a heavy clencher or grinder. The health benefit is the same as R2 and R3.
settings.points:
Lowest cost of the three
Good for trying the concept
- No guarantee, no replacement

How to measure your mouth
1. Measure Your Mouth Width:
○
Use a soft measuring tape or a ruler.
○
Open your mouth slightly and measure the distance between the outer edges of your molars (back teeth).
2. Measure Your Mouth Length:
○
Place the measuring tape from the front of your upper teeth to the back of your molars.
3. Compare with Our Mouthpiece Dimensions:
○
Small Size: 4.7 cm (Length) × 6.0 cm (Width) × 2.5 cm (Height) → Best for teens & small adult mouths.
○
Large Size: 5.0 cm (Length) x 6.7 cm (Width) x 3.0 cm (Height) → Best for most adults.
○
If you're between sizes, we recommend going one size up for comfort.

settings.question: How is R3 different from R1 and R2? Can I start with R3?
settings.answer: R3 is designed to be gentler on gums and to support better airflow, making it a popular starting choice for many customers. Yes, you can absolutely start with R3. Our appliances do not go in any particular order.

settings.question: Do I need to buy R1 first, then R2, then R3?
settings.answer: No. Start with the appliance that matches your needs and your comfort. They are not meant to be used sequentially.

settings.question: What is the guarantee?
settings.answer: R1 has no guarantee. Both R2 and R3 are guaranteed for one year with one free replacement. This replacement warranty is limited to one user per customer and doesn't cover repeat purchases of the same appliance.

settings.question: I am still unsure — what should I do?
settings.answer: Contact support at cs@getreviv.com with your goals (comfort, airflow, grinding, budget) and we'll recommend the best option.

settings.question: Can I add the support package later?
settings.answer: Yes. The appliance works on its own, and support can be added at any time after your purchase.
